description: Start one renewable random receive-only temporary email address with 1 hour, 24 hours, or 7 days prepaid. Price: $0.05 for 3600, $0.20 for 86400, $1.00 for 604800 (duration_seconds). Requires AUSCA_PRIVATE_KEY and AUSCA_MAX_PAYMENT_USD in this server's environment.

inputSchema.description: Create one renewable random receive-only address with a supported initial prepaid duration.

ausca_campaign.description: Optional self-reported campaign attribution; requires ausca_source.

ausca_idempotency_key.description: Required caller-owned purchase identity. Save before payment and reuse with unchanged input to recover an uncertain response. A different key authorizes another purchase.

ausca_source.description: Optional self-reported source attribution. Reporting only; never affects payment or execution.

duration_seconds.description: Initial prepaid duration: 1 hour, 24 hours, or 7 days. Extend the same active inbox when more time is needed.

inputSchema.title: Receive-only agent inbox create input

name: ausca_open_inbox
